purpose: Source inventory and implementation research, not completed extraction evaluation

sources.metric: Customer request error rate greater than 5% in a minute, for covered experiences.
sources.metric_quote: “Downtime Minute” occurs when the Error Rate in a given minute is greater than 5%.
sources.fee_basis: Affected product monthly fees; bundled SKU allocations determined by Atlassian.

cap.basis: affected product amount on the future receiving invoice
cap.scope: aggregate credits applied to that invoice

prerequisites: Account fully paid without overdue payments or disputes
Covered browser experience affected; specific exceptions in Appendix A
sources.maintenance_exclusion: Routine scheduled or reasonable emergency maintenance under the referenced maintenance policy.

sources.metric: Feature error rate above 5% per minute or unavailability determined by GitHub monitoring. Actions and Packages have separate metrics.
sources.claim_channel: GitHub Support for direct purchases; Microsoft support for Microsoft purchases.
sources.notes: Do not use deprecated pre-2021 SLA. Outstanding invoices must be paid; scheduled maintenance definition requires notice except emergencies. Cap expressed as 90 paid-service days, not a generic monthly percentage.

sources.metric: Outage minutes multiplied by affected unique-visitor ratio, divided by scheduled availability minutes.
sources.deadline: End of billing month following affected month; support notification also required within five business days of incident.
sources.cap: Twelve-month aggregate limited to one month of cumulative monthly service fees.
sources.notes: Requires unique-visitor data unavailable from a public status feed. No percentage tier table. Scheduled availability denominator excludes customer-planned downtime and force majeure.

sources.metric: Mean of five-minute request inspection availability, evaluated per region.
sources.deadline: End of second billing cycle following incident
sources.notes: Public outage duration is insufficient; host-service request inspection logs are required.

sources.metric: 100% minus mean five-minute internal-server-error rates for the account.
sources.deadline: End of second billing cycle following incident
sources.notes: Request logs required. SLA includes an exclusion for a non-S3 origin; account configuration must be known.

sources.metric: All authoritative name servers unable to answer; uninterrupted outages shorter than 60 seconds do not count.
sources.deadline: Within 30 days of becoming eligible; anchor needs interpretation for a concrete case.
sources.notes: Name-server query failure logs required. Credit applies to future service use within 60 days after request. No model extraction results have been inspected.

sources.metric: Every request in a minute yields 5xx or no response; external causes excluded.
sources.deadline: Within 30 days of incident through contact page
sources.notes: Enterprise only; tiers overlap as written and require precedence interpretation. Support add-on has separate 30% cap, not a generic EAS uptime cap. No model extraction results have been inspected.

sources.metric: Per-instance connectivity or root-disk access loss attributable to DigitalOcean infrastructure.
sources.deadline: Within two billing cycles of affected month
sources.notes: Scheduled maintenance and customer-initiated downtime excluded. Account email, affected resources, and outage timing required; future credits only. Good eighth source because interval-based evidence is closer to MVP capabilities.
